title: Video by yournishaant
caption:
Neural networks have been using “ artificial neurons “ for a long time now, since the late 50s or so.
A fruit fly brain is 166K neurons and many connections between them.
The artificial fruit fly brain is essentially a 166000 node neural network with inputs coming from neurons that would get signals from the fly’s eyes and such, and outputs that would go to the fly’s muscles.
So it’s essentially an AI whose brain is modelled exactly like the layout of the fruit fly brain.
